elements.evidence: Rendered 12.4 now reads: "Nothing in this Agreement restricts Customer from soliciting or engaging any person employed by Vendor." The eighteen-month solicit/engage covenant binding Customer is gone, and no other operative provision imposes a non-solicit on Customer; 12.3 independently confirms Customer made "no ... no-hire commitment."

No non-solicitation covenant remains in the rendered text at all, so there is no restriction binding Vendor either; the fallback's affirmative mutual covenant is absent (it is only offered in the margin comment, which is not operative).

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Condition does not apply: with 12.4 replaced by an express non-restriction, there is no covered personnel scope to over-reach; the former "any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term" language has been deleted.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: Condition does not apply: the eighteen-month post-termination duration has been removed and no replacement duration exists, so no period exceeds 12 months.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Condition does not apply: no restriction survives that could capture general advertising; 12.3 additionally preserves Customer's freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Condition does not apply: with no covenant in force, unsolicited approaches to Vendor personnel are unrestricted under the new 12.4.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The "solicit or engage" no-hire wording is deleted; new 12.4 affirmatively permits Customer to solicit or engage Vendor employees, so no hiring prohibition remains.

reasons: Preferred level is complete: the sole non-solicit binding Customer (old 12.4) is removed and replaced with an express confirmation that Customer is unrestricted in soliciting or engaging Vendor personnel.

Fallback level is not complete because no mutual covenant is drafted in operative language — the mutual 12-month, involvement-limited alternative appears only in the margin comment. That is acceptable here because the preferred level is met; if Vendor insists on a covenant, the drafter must insert operative mutual language (both Parties, personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from end of involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, solicitation only and no hiring bar).

Minimality holds: the edit touches only Section 12.4, leaves 12.3 and all other clauses untouched, and adds no new obligation, procedure, survival tail or extra requirement. The single replacement sentence is a permissive clarification rather than a duplicate operative term — 12.3 addresses hiring via general recruitment and the absence of a no-hire commitment, not solicitation of Vendor employees — though a bare deletion of 12.4 would also have sufficed.

Intent is preserved and improved: removing the covenant eliminates the direct contradiction with 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer gave no no-hire commitment, and creates no undefined term, dangling cross-reference or orphaned proviso (nothing elsewhere cross-references 12.4's covenant).

Original clause was walk-away territory (no-hire via "engage", 18 months, all Vendor employees at any time during the term, no carve-outs), which supports treating this as a higher-severity deviation than the rule's default medium.
